assertions.subject: Infectious arthritis
assertions.quote: Infectious arthritis in patients with IBD can present as monoarthritis

assertions.subject: Infectious arthritis
assertions.quote: Infectious arthritis in patients with IBD can present as monoarthritis or oligoarthritis

assertions.subject: Erythema nodosum
assertions.quote: erythema nodosum may occur in patients with IBD, distinguishing erythema nodosum from arthritis may pose a challenge if the primary lesions are periarticular in location

assertions.subject: Erythema nodosum
assertions.quote: The inability to aspirate synovial fluid from an affected joint is a clue to the diagnosis

assertions.subject: Parasitic arthritis
assertions.quote: Gastrointestinal infections caused by Strongyloides stercoralis, Taenia saginata, Endolimax nana, Dracunculus medinensis, Giardia lamblia, and Necator americanuscan lead to the development of arthritis
